description: A branch condition: ProcessDef-owned Expression holding a full infix "=" Node AST (Field lhs, Static rhs). The Field carries a bidirectional Field::Node back-ref to every node that references it.
notes: ExpressionStr references the field by ID, not name, and is only the human-readable mirror — the Node tree is what the engine actually evaluates. Keep both in sync on every write.

Category on the root Node is the OPERAND class, not the result: it is "String" here because the compared field is a Select (string-valued); a Boolean-vs-Boolean comparison instead takes Category:"Boolean" (see expression_goto_condition.json). Set it from the operands, never copy DataType (DataType is always "Boolean" — the result of "=" — regardless).

Literals are case-SENSITIVE and completely unvalidated by the write API: a Static whose Value does not byte-for-byte match a live list option means the branch silently never fires. Always read the option list (GET .../list/{id}/items) before writing the literal.

Field::Node must list EVERY node anywhere in the graph that references this field — losing that back-ref does not break the expression itself but breaks whatever else relies on it (e.g. a rewire script that walks Field::Node to find every reference).
